description: This file defines the PagePreviewCanvas class, a custom Windows Forms control used to display a preview of a PDF page within the PdfSharp library. It handles painting of the preview and background, adjusting to size changes, and interacts with a PagePreview object to render the page content.

classes.name: PagePreviewCanvas
classes.description: A Windows Forms control that displays a preview of a PDF page, rendering its content and background.

methods.name: PagePreviewCanvas
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the preview with a PagePreview object and sets control styles for painting.

methods.name: OnPaint
methods.description: Overrides the default paint method to render the PDF page preview.

methods.name: OnPaintBackground
methods.description: Overrides the background painting method to draw the background or clear it if the page is not shown.

methods.name: OnSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles size change events by invalidating the control to trigger repaint.
